prose: Harmonic Security raised a $50M Series B for a platform that inspects what employees send to AI tools before it arrives, using small language models that read each interaction in context and return a verdict within milliseconds. It flags things like live credentials pasted into chats while letting a developer reference a database schema, and has expanded from browsers to desktop apps and agentic workflows (SiliconANGLE).
highlights: Small models screen employee prompts in milliseconds.
Covers browsers, desktop AI apps and agent workflows.
